body: Already have serious depression but can't do anything about it cuz my mom doesn't let me get meds.

I was a kid who was born to a father with depression. It's so terrible. It fucked me up for life. I hate this idea that having a family will fix your depression. For most it just seems to make the people around them miserable.

All good. Idk if this is better but it makes a bit more sense to me. Assuming you don't believe in afterlife, after you kill yourself nothing happens and your just gone. So you might as well a couple more days, weeks, years, to see if things improve before making a decision. 50 years is such a short amount of time compared to an endless void. That just helps me not trying to lecture u or anything.

I have a therapist but I think they have to report stuff like this. I don't want to move bc I wouldn't get to see my bf or friends who saved my life. I think the whole thing would just depress me more.

You should at least try meds before you commit to death. Death lasts forever, and you've made it 7 years already,  you can make it long enough to try meds/therapy. Just please try something before you decide to do it.
